description: The stranger-test script's critical path. Each step a stranger MUST complete unaided for V8-A acceptance. A parked defect whose `stepKey` matches a step with `critical: true` (and is not waived) MUST refuse a stranger session — enforced mechanically by scripts/start-stranger-test.mjs (criticalPathBlockers) and locked by src/tools/critical-path-gate.selftest.mjs. Anti-repeat for the Run-6 abort: L0 (café Send below the embed frame) was parked ON step 2 and the session was allowed to start.

steps.action: Read the 8 answers / see project state at a glance
Try an action that would Send an order and see it honestly refused
Report a problem; see it saved as evidence
Find blocked/unknown files; confirm a secret stays hidden
Ask a question; get a plain-English answer with a cited source
Find what is waiting / read the decision (view only)
Pause & get help; see do-not-touch files
